correctness.rationale: For each row simplex, a rational positive-definite Q has precisely n+1 unit contact points with zero weighted mean and shape-matched weighted second moment, giving a John certificate. Placing the contacts in individual row blocks yields the John certificate for the product of m simplices. The extra column-sum support is exactly (m+sqrt(m))/(n+1), proving both necessity and sufficiency by containment and the product-volume upper bound. Integer arithmetic fixes all equality dimensions; spectral determinants give volume. The supplied standalone checker replays exact rational contact identities for n=2..12 and 2014 finite screening comparisons; those corroborate but do not substitute for the all-dimension proof. No boundary m=1 or n=1 is asserted.

value.rationale: The complete-bipartite matching polytope is a natural irredundant intersection of row simplices with coupling column caps; finding exactly when the coupling caps do not alter the unique global maximum-volume inscribed ellipsoid is a structural geometry question. The theorem supplies a sharp all-dimension if-and-only-if aspect-ratio transition, every squared semiaxis, exact Euclidean volume, all contact facets, and an infinite arithmetic boundary (m,n)=(s²,s²+s−1) where column tangency first appears. It contrasts with the known square all-facets-contacting phase, not an arbitrary finite slice or restatement of integrality.
